data.name: Azreeb
data.gender_notes: Azreeb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One Who Gives or Supplies
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘azr’, meaning ‘to give’ or ‘to supply’. In Islamic context, the name Azreeb refers to the one who provides sustenance and blessings. It is a name deeply rooted in the spiritual essence of Islam. The name Azreeb carries the meaning “The One Who Gives or Supplies” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azreeb usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who gives or supplies and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of blessings and provision from Allah
data.etymology: Azreeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Gives or Supplies.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azreeb total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hindi.name: अज्रीब

in_pashto.name: ازريب
in_pashto.long_meaning: ازريب دا معنا ده، چې د لمر په وخته څه باندې لمر له ځان سره نږدې کوي، د نړۍ د نورو لپاره څرګندويي، خپل ځان ته نږدې کوي. دا نوم د افغانستان په ټولټال کې د لمر او د نړۍ لپاره ځانګړی معنا لري.

in_english.name: Azreeb
in_english.meaning: The daybreak, aurora, dawn, light, radiance, and glory
in_english.long_meaning: Azreeb is an Arabic name that means daybreak, aurora, and dawn. It symbolizes light, radiance, and glory. This name is associated with the Quranic verse (Quran 6:97) that describes the dawn. Azreeb is also a name that represents the light of knowledge, wisdom, and guidance.
